data = open('/app/main.db-wal.bak','rb').read()
open('/app/main.db-wal','wb').write(bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in data))
print('fixed WAL, header:', open('/app/main.db-wal','rb').read(8).hex(' '))
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('/app/main.db')
rows = [{"id": i, "name": n, "value": v} for i, n, v in
        con.execute("SELECT id, name, value FROM items ORDER BY id")]
con.close()
with open('/app/recovered.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(rows, f)
print(len(rows), 'records written')
print(json.dumps(rows))
EOF
echo '--- integrity/check ---'
sqlite3 /app/main.db "PRAGMA integrity_check; SELECT count(*) FROM items;"
